question_text: If 3a+2b+4c=0, show that ax+by+c=0 represents a family of concurrent lines, and find the point of concurrency.

steps.why: A point that satisfies ax + by + c = 0 for every allowed a, b and c lies on every line of the family, so all the lines pass through it. That single statement both proves concurrency and names the point.
